intro: Argos Nightwhisper is a night elf emissary found in the Park district of Stormwind City. He serves as an Alliance contact directing adventurers toward Teldrassil to aid his people against spreading corruption.

sections.t: A Kaldorei in the Human Capital
p: Argos Nightwhisper resides among the growing night elf presence in Stormwind, often lingering in the lush, secluded Park district crafted to remind the kaldorei of their ancestral woodlands. Like many of his kin stationed in the human kingdom, Argos acts as a bridge between the newfound allies across the Great Sea. Deeply concerned by reports filtering across the ocean, he urges capable Alliance champions to journey west to Darnassus and assist in purging the dark taint creeping through the roots of Teldrassil.
